boundary.title: Harness
boundary.summary: The durable cognitive execution boundary for one bounded Agent Run: canonical history, Agent-selected cognition, interaction/attempt context, request-bound action authority, Provider/Tool recovery, receipts, and completion proposals.
boundary.thesis: Preserve the structural truth of one Agent Run while leaving semantic cognition and action choice with the Agent and Task/domain meaning with the caller.
boundary.question: Which structural facts must survive interruption so an Agent can resume from exact current cognition and authority without Harness choosing relevance, world truth, or Task completion?
owns: Canonical bounded-Run history and immutable Run authority
Provider/Tool effect fencing, recovery, receipts, and CompletionProposal
boundary: No generic Task/domain database or final acceptance
No semantic ranking, Memory/RAG truth, or automatic knowledge promotion
No generic Provider-opaque continuation or Mandate scheduler

project.label: Durable cognitive execution for bounded Agent Runs
project.problem: A bounded Agent Run must preserve what happened, what the Agent is currently allowed to know and do, and what effects actually occurred without collapsing all of that into one transcript or letting recovery invent semantic truth.
project.capability: Provides independent Journal/CAS Run authority plus Agent-selected WorkingSet cognition, caller interaction and attempt-local Tool context, request-bound action capabilities, Provider/Tool response-loss recovery, bounded cognition history, exact cross-Run source admission, and the supported HarnessAgentRun Python composition surface.
project.maturity: Operational pre-1.0 engineering prototype with a supported caller-facing Agent Run surface
project.audience: Agent builders who need durable bounded execution, explicit cognition/action authority, exact Provider/Tool recovery, and caller-owned completion semantics without a Host or generic Memory/RAG dependency.
project.latestProof: Current Status and Architecture freeze six distinct state domains—canonical history, durable cognition, interaction cognition, attempt cognition, execution control, and effects—while HarnessAgentRun provides the supported Python composition surface. Recent verification work binds typed evidence to creation lineage and fails closed on structured-result conformance without promoting semantic evaluation or Provider continuation into Harness.
project.summary: The independent durable cognitive execution substrate for bounded Agent Runs. Harness preserves exact structural cognition, action, and effect continuity while the Agent chooses semantic cognition/action and the caller/domain retains Task meaning and final acceptance.
project.state: Operational pre-1.0. One independent Harness Journal/CAS owns bounded Run continuity; Agent-selected cognition is distinct from history, current action authority is request-bound, ambiguous Provider/Tool effects are recovered conservatively, and HarnessAgentRun is the supported normal Python composition surface. Generic Memory/RAG, semantic ranking, Provider-opaque continuation, Strategy scheduling, and domain completion remain outside Harness.
